description: PÁIR is Hungary's market price information system, run by the Institute of Agricultural Economics (AKI) to meet EU market reporting rules. About 300 market players above a legal size threshold must report prices and quantities, covering around two thirds of turnover in most product chains, including grain, oilseeds, pigs, cattle, poultry, eggs, milk, fruit and vegetables and wine. The agricultural information portal publishes the results as query tables: weekly and monthly prices and quantities of the main products, producer and processor prices by chain, and daily prices of domestic and imported fruit and vegetables at the Budapest Wholesale Market, with archived data back to 2004. The tables are free and available to download through an Excel export, and AKI also publishes market reports in PDF; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the portal is in Hungarian, reporting thresholds exclude small traders, and some series changed methods over time. Simulation uses: tracking price transmission along food chains, detecting supply shocks from drought or animal disease through price jumps, and calibrating food system models for Hungary. Related records: the WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) cover consumer markets worldwide, and the OKAA Athens market statistics (data-okaa-athens-central-market-statistics) are a comparable wholesale source.
